pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 28400-28419 (label lemma-Rlim-perfect-gives-perfect, canonical tag 0CQG): for an inverse system of rings with surjective transition maps having locally nilpotent kernels and compatible objects satisfying the perfectness or eventual perfectness hypothesis and the reduction isomorphisms, the derived limit is perfect and is recovered by reduction.
